name: fuzemobi-plugins
description: Public Claude Code plugins by fuzemobi

plugins.name: doc-extract
plugins.description: Structural extraction from any document — PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, HTML, EPUB — headings, tables, form fields, and reading order instead of raw character dumps.

plugins.name: carrier-tower-research
plugins.description: Build authoritative cell-tower master lists for any mobile carrier — FCC ULS/ASR/FAA/BDC/ECFS, international regulators, and crowdsourced RF observations, merged in explicit trust order with per-row provenance.

plugins.name: team-mode
plugins.description: A config-driven multi-agent engineering team for Claude Code — research → plan → work → review → ship, with structured voting, domain-owner vetoes, machine-verified done gates, context handoffs, and GitHub-native workflow.
